story.headline: Miami pulls away from Michigan, 28-17
body: Miami asserted control when it mattered in a 28-17 win over Michigan in Week 12 PCFL action, with Romeo Dixon earning Player of the Game honors after going for 58 rushing yards and 2 rushing TDs.
The Hurricanes were outgained by Michigan 402–346 in total offense, including 136 yards on the ground. Michigan kept fighting, managing 402 total yards on the night.

story.headline: UCLA steamrolls Georgia, 31-10
body: UCLA dominated from start to finish in a 31-10 rout over Georgia in Week 12 PCFL action, with Nico Iamaleava earning Player of the Game honors after going for 15 of 27 for 168 yards and 2 TDs.
The Bruins were outgained by Georgia 373–279 in total offense, including 121 yards on the ground. Georgia kept fighting, managing 373 total yards on the night.
Up next, UCLA travels to face Texas in Week 13.

body: Texas dominated from start to finish in a 44-6 rout over Penn State in Week 12 PCFL action, with Quintrevion Wisner earning Player of the Game honors after going for 69 rushing yards and 3 rushing TDs, 3 catches for 42 yards.
